chosen_cost.target: Repeated full body/road/obstacle margin; dominant instrumented geometry family
chosen_cost.evidence: 919 corner515.margin calls cumulative16.288s, road margin15.770s; point_segment4485256 calls cumulative4.974s. These are overlapping profiled times, not normal latency.
chosen_cost.change: One fresh per-choose memo of exact full margin. Key contains every input used by plan513.polygons: center, planar.angle, levers and each wheel.heading, preserving finite binary64 type/signedzero. Geometry context is recursively immutable and privately owned. All other root fields are unused by polygons/margin. On miss call the original margin with unchanged arithmetic/control-flow order; on hit reuse that exact immutable float. All original logical query counters/admission/body/force gates execute.
chosen_cost.boundaries: Cache only one choose, maximum5000 keys, no history/action/report/control state in entries, clear on exit. Other geometry projection/contact/physics functions unchanged. Geometry budget counts logical queries including cache hits.
